title: Hastings did not systematically ask witnesses whether they saw beings
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hastings did not systematically ask witnesses whether they saw beings, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this conversation with Bob Hastings in the past where I say, "Did you did you systematically ask all of the whistleblowers who just seen crafts whether they've seen beings themselves?" And he said, "No."

related.note: This is the same conversation between Jesse and Hastings about how many witnesses saw beings, but here Hastings says he never asked them systematically instead of giving a count.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says he once asked Robert Hastings, a researcher who collected accounts of strange craft seen near US nuclear weapons sites, whether he had asked every witness who saw a craft if they had also seen beings. According to Michels, Hastings said no. Michels raises it to suggest that encounters with beings could be more common among those witnesses than Hastings's figures show.
